sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Increases Ability cooldown times by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 50

[Snow Dragon Princess] Evie or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
